studyDesign: Single-arm, prespecified multi-run, budget-limited closed-loop software-system observation; no paid A/B required.
targetScope: Airborne control only; touchdown and documented departure exit may respawn after outcome measurement.
currentScope: Airborne-only runtime by default; explicit legacy test fixtures remain separately labeled.

units.command: One schema-accepted aircraft route/altitude/IAS/rate bundle in one plan revision and aircraft generation.
units.finding: One triggered detector rule within that command.
units.frame: One frozen plan; includes multiple correlated aircraft commands and HTTP batches.
units.flight: Aircraft identifier plus generation, within a run.
units.run: An independently initialized, frozen configuration and seed; not one HTTP request.

commandRules.predicate: HOLD: command altitude < frozen holding minimum.
commandRules.interpretation: Target conflict with a sourced minimum; not a measured altitude violation.

commandRules.predicate: HOLD: command IAS > published maxSpeed if present; otherwise 200/230/265 kt for altitude <=6000/<=14000/>14000 ft at receipt.
commandRules.interpretation: Default speeds are simulator assumptions, not certified local limits.

commandRules.predicate: Active next leg: command altitude < exact altitude or minAltitude.
commandRules.interpretation: Immediate target-versus-next-leg diagnostic; not proof that a future crossing will be missed.

commandRules.predicate: Active next leg: command altitude > exact altitude or maxAltitude.
commandRules.interpretation: Immediate target-versus-next-leg diagnostic; subsequent commands may change the target.

commandRules.predicate: Active next leg: command IAS != exact speed, or command IAS > maxSpeed.
commandRules.interpretation: Exact requested-target comparison; physical crossing measurement separately uses +/-5 kt.

commandRules.predicate: APP index <= FAP index: command altitude < sourced FAP altitude.
commandRules.interpretation: Simulator-wide pre-FAP floor interpretation using published data; NOT a claim of universal operational applicability.

commandRules.predicate: Selected APP runway != stored landingClearance, including missing clearance.
commandRules.interpretation: Legacy integration rule couples approach and landing permission; not an aviation-law label.

commandRules.predicate: At receipt actual altitude <10000 ft AND command IAS >250 kt.
commandRules.interpretation: Simplified simulator rule; no regional exceptions modeled.

commandRules.predicate: SID, below climbGradientUntil and target > actual altitude +150 ft: command rate < minClimbFtPerNm * no-wind current groundSpeedKt /60.
commandRules.interpretation: Instantaneous kinematic test, not a full trajectory-feasibility assessment. Unknown speed is not a proven compliant departure.

metrics.commandConflictFraction: commands with >=1 finding / checked aircraft-command bundles, in the same evaluation epoch
metrics.publishedConflictFraction: commands with >=1 published-basis finding / checked commands
metrics.simulatorRuleConflictFraction: commands with >=1 demo-rule finding / checked commands
metrics.integrationConflictFraction: commands with >=1 integration-rule finding / checked commands
metrics.perRuleCounts: At most once per rule per command. No applicability-normalized rate is claimed.
metrics.physicalLimitRequestFraction: commands requesting rate above the modeled aircraft rate ceiling / checked commands; not a procedure finding
metrics.accidentEventRate: 100 * (collision-group events + ground-impact events) / airborne aircraft-hours, using evaluation-start counter deltas. Composite events, not unique accident probability.
metrics.counting: A repeated newly accepted command counts again. Physics ticks, forecast clones, report reads and stale/invalid rejected responses do not count as accepted commands.

separation.unit: pair episode; re-count only after separation recovery

collision.unit: Connected swept-overlap group within one <=1-second substep, before terminal removal.

measurements.procedureCounting: One finding per category + route/rule/fix key in an aircraft generation; not duration, not each tick.
measurements.timing: Physics substeps <=1 simulated second; 60s regular decision horizon; forecast up to 120s; critical trigger <=45s with 10s cooldown. Provider waits, no viewers and exhausted budgets pause simulated time.
measurements.surfaceModel: 0 ft MSL background with 60 m wide elevated runway strips; no terrain database.
measurements.touchdown: Actual runway-strip surface contact, assigned runway, heading error <15 deg, IAS <=190 kt, contact sink <=900 fpm; simulator assumptions.
measurements.departureExit: SID complete or sector boundary; radius >=30 NM, outward heading, no predicted pair conflict in next120 seconds. Measure first, remove last.

retention.commandRecords: Flagged-only rolling window, not a random or representative sample.

reporting.noFinding: No finding under implemented applicable detectors, NOT proof of procedural compliance or safety.
reporting.attribution: Command references establish temporal association, not causal attribution.
reporting.confidence: Distribution concentration, NOT probability of no accident; calibration against future safety is not claimed.
reporting.oldRuns: No historical backfill, no fabricated denominators, do not pool policy versions.
reporting.statistics: Report run/flight dependence. Never use 403 question outputs as 403 independent trials. Single-run rates are descriptive; no automatic p-values or independent-binomial intervals.
reporting.stopping: Freeze a run manifest with seeds, exposure target, credit cap and infrastructure stop rules before the evaluated run. No stopping because results look favorable.

references.title: TypeSafe state: independent questions over shared state

seedPolicy: sha256-plan-index-v1; all derived seeds included in index order with no outcome filtering.
runOrdering: Sequential plan-index order; overlapping/out-of-order evaluated run windows are rejected by cohort aggregation.
